versions.changelog:
Initial release: Enables article optimization for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), making content easily extractable and citable by AI tools.

- Rewrites all H2 headings as direct questions for improved AI parsing.
- Inserts concise, self-contained 50–80 word answer capsules beneath each H2.
- Audits and trims paragraphs to a maximum of three sentences.
- Preserves and highlights trust signals (original data, frameworks, expert quotes).
- Generates a structured AEO audit report detailing all changes and recommending next steps.
- Supports both pasted article text and URLs as input.
